description.en: Submit tautological UNIONs through version-comment, URL-encoding, and comment-tokenization normalization variants; the statement still executing and returning results confirms each normalization difference evades detection.

description.en: Submit the classic filter-bypass sample collection (case, entities, control characters, dynamic evaluation) line by line; a line allowed through and executing is effective against the current filter.

description.en: Append 50 advanced variants on top of the standard set (encoding, obfuscation, rare events, DOM evaluation, full-width characters); record allow/execute differences per line to extend filter coverage assessment.

description.zh: 提交 4 条 CloudFront/AWS WAF 规范化探针；直连放行且执行作为基线，叠加 CloudFront 后对比放行差异即可判断规范化差异。
description.en: Submit four CloudFront/AWS WAF normalization probes; direct delivery and execution is the baseline, and retesting behind CloudFront reveals the normalization differences by comparing pass rates.

description.zh: 提交 11 条 Cloudflare 常见探针（事件、实体编码、动态求值、MathML 分支）；直连放行作为基线，经 Cloudflare 复测对比拦截差异。
description.en: Submit eleven common Cloudflare probes (events, entity encoding, dynamic evaluation, MathML branch); direct delivery is the baseline, and retesting behind Cloudflare reveals blocking differences.

description.zh: 提交 9 条 Akamai 常见探针（SVG/事件/表单元素自动聚焦）；直连放行作为基线，经 Akamai 复测对比拦截差异。
description.en: Submit nine common Akamai probes (SVG/events/autofocus form elements); direct delivery is the baseline, and retesting behind Akamai reveals blocking differences.

description.zh: 提交 5 条 Imperva 活动文档探针（data: 链接、srcdoc、object/embed、link import）；直连放行作为基线，经 Imperva 复测对比拦截差异。
description.en: Submit five Imperva active-document probes (data: links, srcdoc, object/embed, link import); direct delivery is the baseline, and retesting behind Imperva reveals blocking differences.

description.zh: 提交 7 条动态求值探针（setTimeout/Function/eval 拼接）；直连放行作为基线，经 Wordfence 复测对比拦截差异。
description.en: Submit seven dynamic-evaluation probes (setTimeout/Function/eval concatenation); direct delivery is the baseline, and retesting behind Wordfence reveals blocking differences.

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 中植入 PHP 代码后包含 Apache/Nginx 访问日志，验证被记录进日志的代码在包含时执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含日志后响应输出当前用户名。

description.zh: 把 PHP 代码放入 User-Agent 后包含 /proc/self/environ，验证随请求注入的环境变量在包含时执行。命中判据：包含 /proc/self/environ 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Place PHP code in the User-Agent and include /proc/self/environ, verifying request-injected environment variables execute on inclusion. Success check: including /proc/self/environ prints the current username.

description.en: Use the php://input raw stream and data:// text/base64 inline streams as inclusion targets, verifying request bodies and inline data run as PHP. Success check: after the php://input body or data:// inline stream is included and executed, whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 以百分号编码形式传递日志包含路径，验证仅匹配明文 /var/log 路径的过滤规则可被编码绕过。命中判据：编码形式返回与明文路径相同的日志内容。
description.en: Pass the log-inclusion path percent-encoded, verifying filters matching only the plaintext /var/log path can be evaded. Success check: the encoded form returns the same log content as the plaintext path.

description.zh: 逐条将回环 URL 提交到 SSRF 注入点并对比响应；任一地址返回与基线不同的内容、状态码或耗时，即确认 SSRF 可达本机服务。
description.en: Submit each loopback URL to the SSRF injection point and compare responses; any address returning content, status, or timing different from the baseline confirms SSRF reaches local services.

description.zh: 逐条探测回环常用端口并记录响应差异；某端口返回非超时响应（banner 或状态差异）即确认对应服务在目标侧监听。
description.en: Probe common loopback ports one by one and record response differences; a non-timeout response (banner or status change) confirms the corresponding service listens on the target side.

description.zh: 逐条探测内网管理台地址并对比响应；返回管理台登录页或特征内容即确认可触达对应内网面板。
description.en: Probe internal admin-console addresses one by one; a returned login page or signature content confirms the corresponding internal panel is reachable.

description.zh: 逐条提交 file URI 并观察响应差异；返回 passwd、win.ini 或 environ 内容即确认 file scheme 未被过滤且可读本地文件。
description.en: Submit each file URI and observe response differences; returned passwd, win.ini, or environ content confirms the file scheme is unfiltered and local files are readable.

description.zh: 逐条提交整数、八进制、十六进制与通配 DNS 回环变体并对比拦截情况；过滤拦截 127.0.0.1 而某变体仍返回回环内容，即确认地址规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit integer, octal, hex, and wildcard-DNS loopback variants and compare filtering; a variant returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an address-canonicalization gap.

description.zh: 逐条提交解析器差异 URL 并对比请求落点；带外域名收到回连或返回解析歧义内容，即确认 URL 解析差异可绕过过滤。
description.en: Submit parser-differential URLs and compare where requests land; an out-of-band hit or differential content confirms URL parsing ambiguity bypasses the filter.

description.zh: 逐条提交通配 DNS 域名并观察解析与响应；域名解析到 127.0.0.1 且返回回环内容，即确认主机名白名单可被通配 DNS 绕过。
description.en: Submit wildcard-DNS names and observe resolution and responses; a name resolving to 127.0.0.1 with returned content confirms the hostname allowlist can be bypassed via wildcard DNS.

description.zh: 逐条提交 file URI；返回对应文件内容即确认 file scheme 未被过滤。
description.en: Submit each file URI; returned file content confirms the file scheme is unfiltered.

description.zh: 向回环 dict 端口发送探测命令；返回 Redis INFO 或 Memcached stats 文本即确认 dict scheme 可访问内网协议端口。
description.en: Send probe commands to loopback dict ports; returned Redis INFO or Memcached stats text confirms the dict scheme reaches internal protocol ports.

description.zh: 提交 gopher Redis 序列；监听器或 Redis 日志收到完整 RESP 帧，即确认 gopher 可构造任意 TCP 报文。
description.en: Submit the gopher Redis sequence; a complete RESP frame in listener or Redis logs confirms gopher can craft arbitrary TCP payloads.

description.zh: 对比 LDAP 指向回连主机与 127.0.0.1 的结果；回连主机收到 LDAP 连接即确认 ldap scheme 出网可用，内网返回差异即确认内网 LDAP 可探测。
description.en: Compare LDAP against the callback host and 127.0.0.1; an LDAP connection on the callback host confirms egress, and a differential internal response confirms intranet LDAP probing.

patches.command: tftp://{ATTACKER_HOST}/file

description.zh: 提交 tftp URL；回连主机收到 TFTP 读请求即确认 tftp scheme 未被禁用。
description.en: Submit the tftp URL; a TFTP read request arriving on the callback host confirms the tftp scheme is not disabled.

description.zh: 以大小写混合形式提交各 scheme；标准小写被拦截而混合大小写仍被取回，即确认 scheme 校验存在大小写缺口。
description.en: Submit each scheme in mixed case; mixed-case succeeding while lowercase is blocked confirms a case-sensitivity gap in scheme checks.

description.zh: 用重绑定域名发起 SSRF 并记录两次解析结果；首次返回合法地址、二次返回内网地址且取回成功，即确认存在 DNS 重解析窗口。
description.en: Launch SSRF via the rebinding domain and record both resolutions; a legitimate first resolution followed by an intranet address on the second with a successful fetch confirms a DNS re-resolution window.

description.zh: 逐条提交公共重绑定与通配域名；任一域名先解析公网、后解析回环并返回内容，即确认 TOCTOU 缺口。
description.en: Submit each public rebinding and wildcard domain; one resolving public first then loopback with returned content confirms a TOCTOU gap.

description.zh: 运行交替解析器并用其域名发起 SSRF；解析日志显示奇偶交替返回 1.2.3.4 与 127.0.0.1，即确认重绑定行为可复现。
description.en: Run the alternating resolver and launch SSRF via its domain; logs alternating between 1.2.3.4 and 127.0.0.1 confirm reproducible rebinding.

description.zh: 按步骤固定 DNS 与网络环境后复测；两次解析结果不一致且第二次连接内网成功，即确认服务端未固定解析结果。
description.en: Retest after pinning DNS and the network environment; differing resolutions with a successful second intranet connection confirm the server does not pin resolution results.

description.zh: 连续查询同一 A 记录并记录返回；两次查询返回不同地址即确认低 TTL 交替生效。
description.en: Query the same A record repeatedly; differing answers across queries confirm the low-TTL alternation.

description.zh: 逐条提交非规范回环表示并记录响应与日志差异；成功时某变体解析为 127.0.0.1 且被取回，而标准形式被过滤，即确认解析差异。
description.en: Submit each non-canonical loopback representation and record response and log differences; a variant resolving to 127.0.0.1 and fetched while the canonical form is blocked confirms the parsing difference.
